excerpt.zh: 乍看上去，[Root.GetPlanetMoon]似乎不能支持生命的存在，但我们探测到了从冰冻的地表以下发出的生命信号。
excerpt.en: At first glance this [Root.GetPlanetMoon] does not seem capable of supporting living beings, but nevertheless we have detected life signs emanating from somewhere beneath its frozen surface.

texts.en: At first glance this [Root.GetPlanetMoon] does not seem capable of supporting living beings, but nevertheless we have detected life signs emanating from somewhere beneath its frozen surface.

sections.zh: 乍看上去，[Root.GetPlanetMoon]似乎不能支持生命的存在，但我们探测到了从冰冻的地表以下发出的生命信号。
sections.en: At first glance this [Root.GetPlanetMoon] does not seem capable of supporting living beings, but nevertheless we have detected life signs emanating from somewhere beneath its frozen surface.

texts.zh: 对[From.GetName]进行深度扫描显示，覆盖表层的冰幔下面有很多水暖阀口，这些阀口将一整片大洋加热。首席[Owner.GetScientist][Root.GetLeaderName]从[Root.GetName]派遣了探测器，这些探测器钻透了几里厚的冰层，发现了地下的水体里面充满了生命。我们需要更多的资源进行一次彻底的研究，探查居住在这片深洋里的诸多生命形式。
texts.en: Deep scans of [From.GetName] have revealed a large ocean heated by hydrothermal vents beneath the ice mantle covering the surface. Lead [Owner.GetScientist] [Root.GetLeaderName] dispatched probes from the [Root.GetName] that drilled through several miles of thick ice and found the water below teeming with what appears to be life. We will need more resources to conduct a thorough study of the many unique life forms inhabiting this ocean.

texts.zh: [From.GetName]冰幔下隐藏着大海。科学家希望可以组织一次深海探险以研究此处的特殊生命形态。
texts.en: There is a large ocean hidden beneath the ice mantle of [From.GetName]. Our scientists would like to mount an expedition to study the unique life forms of this environment.

texts.zh: 首席[Owner.GetScientist][Root.GetLeaderName]已经从探险中返回，结束了对[From.From.GetName]冰下之海中的丰富生物圈的调查。在大海的底层区域，科研人员发现了几种大型原生物种，它们能产生一种独特的无机分子，具有十分神奇的疗养性质。如果这种分子能够被成功地大量采集，它将会掀起医疗科学领域的一场革命，甚至可能出现产业规模的应用！
texts.en: Lead [Owner.GetScientist] [Root.GetLeaderName] has returned from the expedition that studied the rich biosphere in the seas beneath the ice mantle of [From.From.GetName]. Several large species native to the lower regions of the global sea have been found to produce a unique, inorganic molecule with immense healing properties. If this molecule is successfully harvested in large enough quantities, it could revolutionize the field of medical science, and may even have industrial applications!

texts.zh:
首席[Owner.GetScientist][Root.GetLeaderName]已经从探险中返回，结束了对[From.From.GetName]冰下之海中的生物圈的调查。在大海的底层区域，我们发现了几种大型原生物种，它们能产生一种独特的无机分子，具有十分神奇的疗养性质。

如果这种分子能够被成功地大量采集，它将会让我们对最亲爱的活体陈设的医疗看护产生革命性的变化，甚至可能出现产业规模的应用！
texts.en:
Lead [Owner.GetScientist] [Root.GetLeaderName] has returned from the expedition that studied the biosphere in the seas beneath the ice mantle of [From.From.GetName]. Several large species native to the lower regions of the global sea have been found to produce a unique, inorganic molecule with immense healing properties.

If this molecule is successfully harvested in large enough quantities, it could revolutionize medical care for our beloved bio-trophies, and may even have industrial applications!

texts.zh: 首席[Owner.GetScientist][Root.GetLeaderName]已经完成了对[From.From.GetName]冰层下海洋中丰富生物圈的考察任务。我们的水下探测器已经绘制了地形图，并记录了大部分生命形式。虽然这些数据可能对我们的生物学家有些用处，但除此之外并未发现任何具有特殊应用价值的东西。
texts.en: Lead [Owner.GetScientist] [Root.GetLeaderName] has returned from the expedition that studied the rich biosphere in the seas beneath the ice mantle of [From.From.GetName]. Our underwater probes have mapped the terrain and cataloged most of the life forms. Although this data may be of some use to our biologists, no particular discoveries have been made that would have any applications beyond that.

texts.zh: 我们并不是在地表之下检测到了生命形式，事实上，是整个星球都检测到了生命！这颗冰封的星球内部布满了微细的管道，相互连接，就像一台原始的计算机。尽管结构很粗糙，它通天的规模意味着，其算力甚至可以匹敌[Owner.Capital.GetName]的某些超级计算机。即使是现在，这台电脑还在活动——我们的[Owner.GetScientistPlural]可以同其互动，但是由于它运转十分缓慢，我们只能询问其一个简单的问题。
texts.en: We didn't detect life forms below the surface. We detected them in the entire world! The frozen planet is interspersed with micro-thin tubes linked like a rudimentary computer. While the structure is primitive, its gigantic scale means it can probably rival some of [Owner.Capital.GetName]'s supercomputers in output. Even now, the computer seems to be active - our [Owner.GetScientistPlural] can interface with it, but since it's so slow, we would only be able to ask it a single question.

label.zh: 你能够解开这些计算吗？

tooltips.zh: 使用这个星球辅助我们计算当前的天体物理困局。
tooltips.en: Use the world to assist in calculating our current astrophysics dilemmas.

label.en: Best to observe it from afar.

summary.text:
# 生命迹象 / Life Signs

- 分类 Category：深空异闻 Exploration · 审阅 Reviewed：2026-10-13（已审阅 reviewed）
- 来源 Sources：common/anomalies/00_anomaly_categories.txt:526; events/anomaly_events_2.txt:42 (anomaly.2510); common/special_projects/00_projects_1.txt (SEA_EXPEDITION_PROJECT); events/anomaly_events_2.txt:90 (anomaly.2512); events/anomaly_events_2.txt:141 (anomaly.2513); events/anomaly_events_4.txt:3369 (anomaly.6900)

## 如何开始 How it starts

没有战略资源的冰冻星球可能生成（2级，权重3）。

Can spawn on a frozen planet without a strategic resource (level 2, weight 3).

## 剧情脉络 Story outline

两个结果各占50%。anomaly.2510“冰下海洋”：d_society_3 矿藏与 subterranean_ocean 修正，并（非机械帝国或机械奴仆公民）启用项目 SEA_EXPEDITION_PROJECT“组织深海探险”（需科学船和科学家，研究180天），完成后随机（各50%）：anomaly.2512（研究加成、活金属矿藏并推进 tech_mine_living_metal）或 anomaly.2513（仅领袖+200经验）。anomaly.6900“冷酷的思绪”：清除矿藏后多个选项（物理研究、社会研究加遗物、符合条件时交出遗物、团结、演化掠食者 DNA、d_engineering_4 矿藏）。

Two results, 50% each. anomaly.2510 "Ocean Beneath the Ice": d_society_3 deposit plus subterranean_ocean modifier, and (for non-machine empires or Machine Servitor) it enables project SEA_EXPEDITION_PROJECT (science ship and scientist, 180 days) which then picks at random (50% each) anomaly.2512 (research bonus, living-metal deposit, tech_mine_living_metal progress) or anomaly.2513 (leader +200 experience only). anomaly.6900 "Cool Thoughts": deposits cleared, then several options (physics research; society research plus artifacts; artifact surrender when an unfinished artifact chain applies; unity; Evolutionary Predators DNA; d_engineering_4 deposit).

## 分支与结局 Branches and outcomes

两个起始结果互斥；2510 的项目结果 2512/2513 也互斥。机械帝国（非奴仆）没有项目，故 2510 在其上无后续。

The two starting results are exclusive; the project results 2512/2513 are also exclusive. Machine empires without Servitor get no project, so 2510 ends there for them.

## 条件与文明差异 Conditions and variants

2510 的项目按机械帝国状态启用；2512 的描述有机械变体；6900 的选项按起源与遗物事件链进度变化。

The project in 2510 depends on machine-empire status; 2512 has a machine description variant; 6900's options depend on origin and artifact-chain progress.

## 审阅记录 Review notes

已核对异常定义、项目与全部结果事件；编译树正确，无需改动。

Checked the anomaly definition, the project and every outcome event; the compiled tree is correct, no change needed.
